acceptanceCriteria: context in a linked worktree pins the worktree's HEAD, or refuses/marks uncertainty when no index exists for it.
A test covers a linked worktree whose HEAD differs from the primary checkout.
body: Expected: `corvint --root WT context` answers for WT's HEAD (0b5096ca). Actual: it answered for revision 21f255f3. Suspected cause: the index/revision is resolved from the shared .git rather than the worktree's HEAD. Reproduce by running context in a linked worktree whose HEAD differs from the primary checkout's. Versions: corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360); corvint-tasks build 202. Observed by lane V1-0981 (worktree /private/tmp/claude-501/corvint-v1-0981, HEAD 0b5096ca), 2026-10-07.

completion.reason: Refuted with evidence: context in a linked worktree answers for that worktree's own HEAD tree; the reported mismatch compared a tree OID with a commit OID. Regression TestContextInALinkedWorktreeAnswersForItsOwnHead covers miss and hit for a linked HEAD that differs from the primary. Landed on main via PR #697 (batch J); independent review passed.

title: context in a linked worktree answers for a different revision than the worktree HEAD (suspected)
